meta.summary: Hides the bookmark banner and share card; optionally hides the carousel, genres, Top Airing, and blurs or hides posters
meta.notes: Checked 2026-11-14 on https://www.miruro.to/ logged out: desktop 1440x900 and an iPhone UA at 393px, headless WebKit. The site is a React single-page app with CSS-module class names whose trailing hash changes per build, so every selector matches the stable name prefix (`[class*="_banner_"]`) and anchors on a role, tag or aria-label where it can. On both viewports the bookmark banner (`[role=status]`), the Love the Site? section, the carousel and the aside were present; the genre strip (18 buttons) and card grid load lazily and were checked on desktop only. Only the home page was inspected; watch and info pages, video ads inside players and logged-in views were not. The fixtures are sanitized excerpts of the capture.
